newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX set new options listings.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX set new options listings.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange and American Stock Exchange each said Thursday they will begin trading options on ITEQ Inc and Zonagen Inc on July 30.
In addition, the CBOE said it would trade options on shares of BJ's Wholesale Club Inc on July 29 and the AMEX said it will list options on CommScope Inc on July 28.
The exchanges said ITEQ options will open with strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2, with expirations in August, September, October and January.
The Amex said position limits of 7,500 contracts have been set and the specialist for the options will be Susquehanna Investment Group.
At the CBOE, ITEQ options will trade in the H.J. Heinz Co trading crowd.
Zonagen options will open with strikes of 30, 35 and 40 and expirations in August, September, November and February.
The options will trade at the CBOE in the Best Buy Co Inc trading crowd.
At the AMEX, where the specialist will be GHM Inc, position limits have been set at 7,500 contracts.
The Amex said CommScope options will have opening strikes of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with position limits of 4,500 contracts.
CommScope is a division of General Instrument Corp .
Expirations will be in August, September, October and January. The specialist will be LETCO-Specialist LP.
At the CBOE, BJ's Wholesale options will open with strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30, with initial expirations in August, September, December and March.
The CBOE said the options will trade in the Boeing Co trading crowd.
BJ's Wholesale will be spun-off from Waban Inc on July 28 to holders of Waban shares as of July 18. BJ's shares currently trade on a when-issued basis.
